title: Better Birch Biome
description: This datapack includes the features of Drop 26.3 such as shelf mushrooms and yellow poplar leaves to give the Birch Forest a better look.
body:
# Better Birch Biome
Better Birch Biome attempts to make birch forests have a more beautiful atmopshere by including features from the upcoming 26.3 drop. This datapack takes inspiration from the birch forest concept art previously shown off by Mojang for 1.19 The Wild Update but wasn't added.

## Features
- Added moss patches below some birch trees
- Added shelf mushroom to fallen and non  fallen birch trees
- Added yellow poplar leaves in certain birch trees
- Added pink petals to the birch forest
  
![Birch forest with moss, yellow poplar leaves, and shelf mushrooms](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/191ef936c52ff7a5698d4ce97e69e8daa9455cd2.png)
